description: Multi-phase plans currently in flight. Each phase references roadmap item ids; the activePhase section breaks the current phase into concrete tasks with status. Survives conversation compactions — a fresh session can pick up by reading this file.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.notes: Schema, bus, episodic memory, agent base. Nothing alive yet — just the substrate everything else hangs off.

phases.title: First Voice
phases.notes: Cheshire Cat end-to-end. Talking to himself. Layered context composer + engagement policy + ADR writer come online here because the Cat is their first consumer.

phases.title: First Tension
phases.notes: Add the White Rabbit. Two voices, role tension, semantic + relational memory layers populated as the agents accumulate history. Compaction-as-behavior arrives because it has to.

phases.title: First Race
phases.notes: Dodo orchestrator + quiescence + conflict resolution + first showcase (/health endpoint). The system runs end-to-end on a trivial directive. Init CLI lands here so the showcase can run against a real target project.

phases.title: Full Cast
phases.notes: Bring the rest of the cast online with integration tests per agent. Per-character artifact handlers for the new speech act payloads. Synthetic-consensus guard goes here because it only matters once disagreement is real.

phases.title: Real Threads
phases.notes: The hard showcases — translation chat MVP, security recovery, multi-session persistence. Transcript annotation tooling lets us publish them. Token telemetry confirms the engagement_policy is paying for itself.

phases.title: Evals
phases.notes: Generic-baseline vs Wonderland comparison. The compounding-curve plot is the legibility-of-value mitigation from §11. Without this the philosophy stays assertion.

activePhase.title: First Race
activePhase.goal: The Dodo comes online; the system runs end-to-end on a real directive without humans in the loop. By end of P4, a Cat + Rabbit + Dodo trio handles the /health endpoint showcase — directive arrives, agents dance, thread reaches done because the team goes quiet (not because anyone said 'we're done'), and the Dodo records the close. Conflict resolution + escalation paths exist in case the dance doesn't compose, even if the showcase doesn't exercise them.
activePhase.sequencing: Dodo agent first — he's structurally different from Cat/Rabbit (state-pattern watcher, not content-deliberator), so he warrants his own foundation. Then the ThreadMonitor (quiescence + stuck + deadlock) — the eyes the Dodo uses to do structured noticing. Then conflict resolution + composition, then escalation — pair them with their state ladder (conflict → compose-or-escalate). Then Showcase 1 ties it together against real LLMs. Init CLI last, optional path to using Wonderland against a target project.

tasks.title: Dodo orchestrator + procedural acts
tasks.details: src/wonderland/agents/dodo.py — Dodo(WonderlandAgent) subclass. Engagement rules from §III (always: external directive, thread state transitions, conflict-invoking concerns, escalation responses; selectively: missing handoffs, unresolved conflicts; never: domain content). DodoResponse Pydantic with decision (nudge/composition/acknowledgment/escalation/silence/relay_directive). Procedural-act-only artifact handlers: ThreadRecord (acknowledgment); composition + escalation lean on T19/T20. Most deliberation is state-machine, not LLM — Dodo only calls LLM for composition synthesis and escalation brief writing.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/agents/dodo.py — Dodo(WonderlandAgent) subclass. Loads constitutions/dodo.md, replaces engagement_policy with make_engagement_policy(dodo_rules()). dodo_rules() encodes §III narrowly: ALWAYS for concern carrying conflict words and for escalation responses; ALMOST_NEVER for directive (Dodo issues, doesn't consume) and deference. Domain content (proposals, tickets, reviews, rulings) is never engaged with — guarding against the §VIII domain-leak failure mode is structurally enforced by the rules table. relay_directive(body, thread_id) publishes a directive utterance with the Dodo as speaker and records it (mechanical, no LLM — Dodo doesn't generate directives, he relays them from external sources). acknowledge(thread_id, state, body=None) publishes an acknowledgment for thread state transitions (running/quiescent/stuck/deadlocked/complete/abandoned) with templated wording or custom body. Default deliberate returns None — per §VIII performing orchestration is a failure mode; per-utterance deliberation is silence and the state-driven actions live in T18+ (ThreadMonitor / conflict flow). 22 mocked tests. 375 total pass; ruff clean.

tasks.title: ThreadMonitor: quiescence + stuck + deadlock
tasks.details: src/wonderland/orchestration/thread_monitor.py — ThreadMonitor class watches the Caucus and tracks per-thread state (utterance counts, last activity, open expectations). Detects: QUIESCENT (no activity for N seconds AND no open concern/question), STUCK (utterance went N turns without expected response, OR deference not picked up), DEADLOCKED (after configured nudge threshold). Returns ThreadState transitions the Dodo subscribes to. Calibration knobs (timeouts, nudge thresholds) start from defaults; Caucus log can refine per-team later.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/thread_monitor.py — ThreadState (running/quiescent/stuck/deadlocked/complete/abandoned), ThreadStateChange dataclass, ThreadInfo per-thread tracker, ThreadMonitor class. Distinguishes quiescence (no activity, no open expectations) from stuck (no activity, open expectations exist) — both detected by the same time-based silence check, distinguished by the open-expectations flag. Open expectation = QUESTION/CONCERN/PROPOSAL/DEFERENCE; closed by any cross-speaker activity (loose heuristic, refinement deferred to P5+). Completion fires on acknowledgment with 'complete' in body — the Dodo's acknowledge() output naturally triggers it. Deadlock fires when nudge_count reaches threshold while still stuck — the Dodo (T19+) records nudges via monitor.record_nudge(thread_id). Background bus consumer + timer task; transitions() async iterator yields changes for consumers. Synchronous bus subscription per the T14 fix so publishes during construction aren't lost. Activity revives non-running threads by silently resetting state to RUNNING — next silence check re-evaluates. 15 mocked tests including end-to-end with Dodo.relay/acknowledge. 390 total pass; ruff clean.

tasks.title: Conflict resolution: domain primacy + composition
tasks.details: Per WONDERLAND_SPEC §7. Domain primacy table mapping speech-act categories to owning agents (user-need → Alice, architecture → Cat, scope → Rabbit, etc.). Detect conflict: two agents with non-composable proposals on same thread. ConflictResolution dataclass: which proposals, primary domain, dissent records (the losing position preserved as part of the resolution artifact). Dodo's composition speech-act publishes the resolution; the dissent stays attached.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/conflict.py — ConflictDomain enum (user_need/architecture/sequence/severity/code_quality/security/production), DOMAIN_PRIMACY lookup table mapping each to canonical agent name per spec §7, domain_owner() helper, Conflict / Dissent / Resolution dataclasses. Resolution exposes is_composition and needs_escalation properties — composed=True with composition_text means publish via COMPOSITION; composed=False with suggested_domain means escalation flow takes over (T20). Dodo extensions in agents/dodo.py: ConflictResponse Pydantic schema (composed bool, composition text, suggested_domain string, dissents list), parse_conflict_response defensive parser, _COMPOSITION_PROTOCOL prompt that explicitly names §VIII 'composition pretending to be decision' as failure mode, compose_conflict_resolution() builds the prompt and invokes LLM, publish_composition() emits the COMPOSITION speech-act with a resolution artifact attached. LLM-free fallback returns non-composing Resolution carrying caller's domain hint. Hallucinated domain → fall back to caller's hint. publish_composition rejects non-composing Resolution explicitly to enforce the §VIII guard. 26 tests covering data shapes, parser, all four LLM/no-LLM paths, artifact attachment, memory recording, and the rejection of non-composing publish attempts. 416 total pass; ruff clean.

tasks.title: Human-in-the-loop escalation
tasks.details: When proposals don't compose or stuck > deadlock, Dodo emits an EscalationBrief per dodo.md §V. Structured: decision_required (specific question, not 'what should we do'), agent_proposals (each with reasoning), suggested_resolution (per domain primacy), stakes, background. Channel: writes to <project_root>/.wonderland/escalations/escalation-NNN.md AND emits via configurable callback (default: stderr). Future: webhook, Slack, etc.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/escalation.py — EscalationBrief Pydantic schema (decision_required + agent_proposals[≥2] + suggested_resolution all required; suggested_owner/domain/stakes/background optional), AgentProposalSchema (speaker/position/rationale/optional domain), EscalationRecord, EscalationRegistry mirroring ADR/Ticket pattern at <project_root>/.wonderland/escalations/, render_escalation producing markdown matching dodo.md §V format. Dodo extensions in agents/dodo.py: BriefProseResponse Pydantic (just the LLM-drafted prose fields — keeps the LLM out of structured fields it could fabricate), parse_brief_response, _BRIEF_PROTOCOL prompt that explicitly tells the LLM not to opine on the decision itself. EscalationChannel callable type (sync or async); stderr_escalation_channel default. Dodo.escalate(conflict, resolution, thread_summary, channel): drafts brief (LLM or fallback), persists via registry, publishes ESCALATION speech-act with brief artifact, emits via channel. Symmetric guards: rejects composing Resolution (the §VIII guard from publish_composition's symmetric direction); requires escalation_registry was injected (lost-brief-without-registry would be worse than failing loudly). Pydantic min_length=2 on agent_proposals — a 'conflict' with one proposal isn't a conflict. 32 tests covering brief validation, render, registry CRUD, parser, both LLM/no-LLM paths, sync + async + default channel emission, ESCALATION utterance + artifact, memory recording, and both guards. 448 total pass; ruff clean.

tasks.title: Alice agent
tasks.details: src/wonderland/agents/alice.py — Alice(WonderlandAgent). Loads constitutions/alice.md, encodes §III as engagement rules. AliceResponse JSON with decision (story/concern/question/silence) and stories[] array (one Alice turn can produce multiple persona-grounded stories). Story shape per alice.md §V: persona, situation, need, acceptance criteria, tier (core | enrichment | fast-follow). StoryRegistry mirrors ADR/Ticket pattern at <project_root>/.wonderland/stories/. Mocked tests + 1 live smoke gated. Required for the showcase (T22) to settle without humans in the loop.
tasks.resolution: src/wonderland/story.py — StoryPayload (Pydantic) per alice.md §V with title/persona/situation/need all required, acceptance min_length=1 with substance validator, tier (core/enrichment/fast-follow), confusion_flags min_length=1 with substance validator (the grin equivalent — required even when nothing felt wrong, mirroring ADR Tradeoffs). StoryRecord, StoryRegistry mirroring ADR/Ticket/Escalation registries at <project_root>/.wonderland/stories/, render_story matching §V format. src/wonderland/agents/alice.py — Alice(WonderlandAgent) subclass mirroring CheshireCat/WhiteRabbit. alice_rules() encodes §III (ALWAYS for directive/question-when-addressed-to-alice/proposal-from-cat/ticket-from-rabbit/test-scenario-from-hatter, SELECTIVELY for implementation/review-from-caterpillar/ruling-from-queen/observation-from-dormouse, RARELY for non-Cat proposals, ALMOST_NEVER for deference). AliceResponse with stories[] requirement when decision='story'. _OUTPUT_PROTOCOL emphasizes inhabited personas ('As Maya, a 31-year-old polyglot moderator...' not 'As the user'). 52 mocked tests + 1 live smoke (passing in 24.25s — Alice produced multiple persona-grounded stories for the translation chat directive). 500 total pass; ruff clean.

tasks.title: Showcase 1: /health endpoint end-to-end
tasks.details: scripts/health_endpoint_showcase.py — Dodo + Alice + Cat + Rabbit live against Haiku 4.5. Directive: 'Add a /health endpoint to a Phoenix app.' Watch happy-path flow: Dodo relays → Alice produces stories → Rabbit decomposes → Cat reframes-or-blesses → Dodo records quiescence/completion. Capture full transcript in analyses/003-first-race.md per the README-update memory. Per WONDERLAND_SPEC §10 — the trivial-directive proof of the orchestration loop.

tasks.title: Project init CLI: wonderland init
tasks.details: src/wonderland/cli.py with  — creates .wonderland/ skeleton in target project (memory dirs, architecture/, tickets/, stories/, escalations/, optionally a config stub). Mirrors 'daedalus init' pattern. Lands last in P4 so the showcase has used its outputs and the CLI emerges from real need. Could slip to early P5 if scope tightens.
